commit_message: Implement ADR 0151 headless MCP writer ownership
pr_title: Implement ADR 0151 headless MCP writer ownership
pr_body: Implements ADR 0151 on current main, including ADR0148 Launcher lifecycle integration for project-writer conflicts, Graph/GraphView saved-file rollback, and clippy follow-up. Adds a GUI-free headless MCP host over the existing engine-mcp inventory, explicit Editor/headless project-writer ownership over the existing OS lock, read-only saved-file coexistence, canonical mutation persistence and rollback, and accepted architecture/spec documentation. Cargo.lock/workspace membership changes require full Windows Validation. Visual Validation is not required because this change has no visible Editor/Launcher presentation changes.
